title.zh: 所得税（Grace Ocean 私人有限公司——第 13(4) 条豁免）公告 2023
title.en: Income Tax (Grace Ocean Private Limited — Section 13(4) Exemption) Notification 2023

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Income Tax (Grace Ocean Private Limited — Section 13(4) Exemption) Notification 2023 and is deemed to have come into operation on 30 September 2019.

2.—(1) The interest payable by Grace Ocean Private Limited during the period from 30 September 2019 to 31 August 2023 (both dates inclusive) in respect of the loan amount of US$6,426,000 under a loan agreement dated 24 September 2019 between Mizuho Bank, Ltd. and Grace Ocean Private Limited, that is used for the purpose of financing the purchase and installation of the exhaust gas cleaning system of the vessel “Dali”, is exempt from tax.
(2) The exemption in sub-paragraph (1) is subject to the conditions specified in the letter from the Ministry of Finance dated 22 March 2023 and addressed to Grace Ocean Private Limited.
